data.name: Settings_Language
data.comment: Settings row label for application wording. A saved choice takes effect after restarting Glideslope.

data.name: Settings_LanguageSystem
data.comment: First option in the application language selector; follows the operating system's display language on each launch.

data.name: Settings_LanguageRestart
data.value: Restart Glideslope for the language change to take effect.
data.comment: Help text under the language selector. It must clearly say the saved language change applies after restarting the app.

data.name: Settings_LanguageSavedRestart
data.value: Language saved. Restart Glideslope to apply it.

data.name: Settings_RestartFailed
data.value: Could not restart Glideslope. Close and reopen it to apply the language.

data.name: Settings_CardSize
data.comment: Settings row label beside a slider from 70 % to 150 % that scales every card.

data.name: Settings_MiniCardSize
data.comment: Settings row label beside a slider from 70 % to 150 % that scales mini cards, directly under Card size.

data.name: Settings_LogFile
data.comment: Settings label above the full path of the app's log file, shown as a link.

data.name: Settings_OpenLogFolder
data.value: Open the folder that holds the log
data.comment: Tooltip on the log file path link in Settings.

data.name: Settings_StartInMiniMode
data.comment: Checkbox directly under Mini card size. When checked, every card opens mini at the next launch; otherwise cards open full. Card modes are not saved at shutdown.

data.name: Settings_CtrlPeek
data.value: Hold Ctrl over a mini card to see it full
data.comment: Checkbox directly under Start in mini mode, on by default. While enabled, holding Ctrl over a hovered mini card shows it full until Ctrl is released, the pointer leaves, or a mouse button goes down.

data.name: Settings_SnapToScreenEdge
data.value: Snap cards together and to screen edges

data.name: Settings_RefreshInterval
data.comment: {0} = the smallest allowed interval (5), {1} = the largest (30), both in minutes.

data.name: Settings_RetentionDays
data.comment: {0} = the fewest days that can be kept (7), {1} = the most (365).

data.name: Settings_AtLeastOneProvider
data.value: Keep at least one provider enabled.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedUnavailable
data.value: Could not apply settings: unavailable. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedNotOwned
data.value: Could not apply settings: not recognized. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedStale
data.value: Could not apply settings: stale launcher. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedLauncherMissing
data.value: Could not apply settings: launcher unavailable. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedRevisionConflict
data.value: Could not apply settings: settings changed elsewhere. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedHistoryUnavailable
data.value: Could not apply settings: usage history is unavailable, so retention could not be applied. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_ApplyFailedHistoryPruneFailed
data.value: Could not apply settings: old usage history could not be removed. Review the message and try again.

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotEnableUnavailable
data.value: Couldn't turn on start at sign-in (unavailable).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotEnableNotOwned
data.value: Couldn't turn on start at sign-in (not recognized).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotEnableStale
data.value: Couldn't turn on start at sign-in (stale launcher).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotEnableLauncherMissing
data.value: Couldn't turn on start at sign-in (launcher unavailable).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotDisableUnavailable
data.value: Couldn't turn off start at sign-in (unavailable).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotDisableNotOwned
data.value: Couldn't turn off start at sign-in (not recognized).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotDisableStale
data.value: Couldn't turn off start at sign-in (stale launcher).

data.name: Settings_StartupCouldNotDisableLauncherMissing
data.value: Couldn't turn off start at sign-in (launcher unavailable).

data.name: Card_Title
data.comment: Window title. {0} = provider name (Codex, Claude or Gemini; never translated).

data.name: Card_MinimumHeight
data.comment: A number, not text: the smallest card height in pixels (at card size 100 %) that fits this language at the 790-pixel minimum width. English 680; text about 30 % longer needs about 790.

data.name: Card_MiniModeTooltip
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the title-row toggle while the card is full; clicking switches its group to mini.

data.name: Card_FullModeTooltip
data.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the title-row toggle while the card is mini; clicking switches its group to full.

data.name: Card_RemainingTooltip
data.comment: {0} = the weekly remaining percentage. Tooltip and accessible name of the mini card's remaining bar.

data.name: Card_Size
data.comment: Tooltip of the title-row button that opens the card size slider, and the heading inside it.

data.name: Card_AppNameVersion
data.comment: {0} = version number, for example 1.1.0. "Glideslope" is the product name.

data.name: Card_MinimizeTooltip
data.comment: Tooltip for the header button that minimizes every card together.

data.name: Card_CloseTooltip
data.comment: {0} = provider name (Codex, Claude or Gemini).

data.name: Card_FooterNoSynthetic
data.value: Pace uses the provider's reported reset schedule. Chart lines use recorded readings only.

data.name: Card_CreditExpiration
data.comment: {0} = uppercase weekday (Card_CreditWeekdayPattern), {1} = date (Card_CreditExpirationDatePattern), {2} = Card_CreditExpiresIn or Card_CreditExpiresToday. Example: THU Oct 22 (in 26 days).

data.name: Card_CreditWeekdayPattern
data.comment: .NET date format for the credit box weekday; the app uppercases it.

data.name: Card_CreditExpirationDatePattern
data.comment: .NET date format for the credit box date and the "Past week" dates. Never add an ordinal suffix.

data.name: Card_CreditExpiresIn_One
data.comment: {0} = number of days until the usage reset expires.

data.name: Card_CreditExpiresIn_Other
data.comment: {0} = number of days until the usage reset expires.

data.name: Card_NoticeSignInClaude
data.comment: "claude" and "/login" are commands; do not translate them.

data.name: Card_NoticeSignInCodex
data.comment: "codex" is a command; do not translate it.

data.name: Card_NoticeSignInGemini
data.comment: "agy" is a command; do not translate it.

data.name: Card_CreditTooltip_NoClick_One
data.comment: {0} = count. This sentence is used at zero or one credit, when the credit flyout is unavailable.

data.name: Card_CreditTooltip_NoClick_Other
data.comment: {0} = count. This sentence is used at zero or one credit, when the credit flyout is unavailable.

data.name: Card_CreditTooltip_Click_One
data.value: You have {0} usage reset total. Click to see the remaining {1}.
data.comment: {0} = total usage resets; {1} = those listed when clicked ({0} minus one). This sentence is used only above one credit, when the credit flyout is available. Noun grammar still follows the language's plural category.

data.name: Card_CreditTooltip_Click_Other
data.value: You have {0} usage resets total. Click to see the remaining {1}.
data.comment: {0} = total usage resets; {1} = those listed when clicked ({0} minus one). This sentence is used only above one credit, when the credit flyout is available. Noun grammar still follows the language's plural category.

data.name: Card_CreditUndisclosed_One
data.value: {0} additional usage reset with undisclosed expiration
data.comment: {0} = number of usage resets whose expiration the provider does not report.

data.name: Card_CreditUndisclosed_Other
data.value: {0} additional usage resets with undisclosed expiration
data.comment: {0} = number of usage resets whose expiration the provider does not report.

data.name: Card_FableThisWeek
data.comment: "Fable" is a model name; do not translate it.

data.name: Card_FableThisWeekWithReset
data.comment: {0} = reset date and time (Card_DateTimeFormat), for example Sat, Sep 26 · 6:00 AM.

data.name: Card_ChartWindowHint
data.value: The chart spans the provider-reported weekly window. Blue shows recorded samples.

data.name: Card_WindowNotStarted
data.value: No usage yet · the window starts with your first request

data.name: Card_NoUsageYet
data.comment: Short form of Card_WindowNotStarted for the narrow Fable pace cell.

data.name: Card_ResetAfterFirstUse
data.comment: {0} = a duration phrase, Card_DurationDays or Card_DurationHours, for example "7 days".

data.name: Card_DurationHours_One
data.comment: {0} = whole number of hours.

data.name: Card_DurationHours_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole number of hours.

data.name: Card_DurationDays_One
data.comment: {0} = whole number of days.

data.name: Card_DurationDays_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole number of days.

data.name: Card_HistoryUnavailable
data.value: Usage history unavailable; live reads continue

data.name: Card_PlanType
data.comment: {0} = the plan name as the provider reports it (for example max, pro); not translated.

data.name: Card_PastWindow
data.comment: {0} = first day of the week shown, {1} = its last day, both in Card_CreditExpirationDatePattern.

data.name: Card_StatusLine
data.comment: The card's status line. {0} = status title (shown bold, for example "Live provider data"), {1} = its details sentence. Reorder or change the separator as needed.

data.name: Card_ResetAt
data.comment: {0} = reset date and time (Card_DateTimeFormat).

data.name: Card_ResetAtWithTimeLeft
data.comment: {0} = reset date and time (Card_DateTimeFormat), {1} = time left until the reset (Card_TimeLeftDays, Card_TimeLeftHours or Card_TimeLeftMinutes). Example: Resets Thu, Oct 1 · 6:00 AM (2.1 days).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftDays_One
data.comment: {0} = days left until the reset, with one decimal (for example 2.1).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftDays_Other
data.comment: {0} = days left until the reset, with one decimal (for example 2.1).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftHours_One
data.comment: {0} = hours left until the reset (under one day): whole hours on the weekly line, one decimal on the 5-hour line (for example 1.0).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftHours_Other
data.comment: {0} = hours left until the reset (under one day): whole hours on the weekly line, one decimal on the 5-hour line (for example 1.1).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftMinutes_One
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes left until the reset (under one hour).

data.name: Card_TimeLeftMinutes_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes left until the reset (under one hour).

data.name: Card_DateTimeFormat
data.comment: {0} = weekday and date (Card_WeekdayDatePattern), {1} = time in the user's regional short-time format.

data.name: Card_WeekdayDatePattern
data.comment: .NET date format for reset and reading dates, for example Sat, Sep 26.

data.name: Card_ChartDayPattern
data.comment: .NET date format for the chart's day labels; the app uppercases it. Keep it short: seven labels share the chart width.

data.name: Card_PacePercent
data.comment: {0} = pace percent, a whole number: use relative to the allowance expected to be spent by now.

data.name: Card_PaceSuppressedHistorical
data.value: Pace unavailable: waiting for a fresh reading

data.name: Card_PaceSuppressedWindowNotStarted
data.value: Pace unavailable: window has not started

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableMissingDuration
data.value: pace percent unavailable: window duration unavailable
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · " (the {1} of Card_UnderBudget*/Card_OverBudget*/Card_OnBudget).

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableMissingReset
data.value: pace percent unavailable: reset time unavailable
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableStale
data.value: pace percent unavailable: reading is stale
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableAuthentication
data.value: pace percent unavailable: sign-in needs attention
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableAccountChanged
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableHistorical
data.value: pace percent unavailable: waiting for a fresh reading
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableWindowNotStarted
data.value: pace percent unavailable: window has not started
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableWindowReset
data.value: pace percent unavailable: window has reset
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableInsufficientElapsed
data.value: pace percent unavailable: window just started
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_PacePercentUnavailableUnknown
data.comment: Follows a budget sentence after " · ".

data.name: Card_OnBudget
data.comment: {0} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_UnderBudgetMinutes_One
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes of allowance left above even pace, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_UnderBudgetMinutes_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes of allowance left above even pace, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_UnderBudgetHours_One
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal (for example 0.8 or 1.0), {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_UnderBudgetHours_Other
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal (for example 13.4), {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_OverBudgetMinutes_One
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes of allowance used beyond even pace, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_OverBudgetMinutes_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole minutes of allowance used beyond even pace, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_OverBudgetHours_One
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_OverBudgetHours_Other
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal, {1} = Card_PacePercent or a Card_PacePercentUnavailable* phrase.

data.name: Card_QuotaGuardDetails
data.value: Glideslope stopped reading this provider to protect your quota. Restart Glideslope to try again.
data.comment: Follows Card_SchemaChanged when the provider's tool answered in a way that could have spent quota; only a restart clears it.

data.name: Card_NoResponse
data.comment: Status title when the provider's command-line tool gave no answer in time. {0} = provider name, for example Gemini.

data.name: Card_NoResponseDetails
data.value: Press Refresh. If this persists, try restarting Glideslope.
data.comment: Follows Card_NoResponse. "Refresh" is the card's Refresh button (Card_Refresh).

data.name: Card_ConnectingDetails
data.value: Waiting for the first read from this provider. No quota values are invented.

data.name: Card_ReadingDetails
data.value: Reading current usage from the provider's signed-in account.

data.name: Card_StaleDetails
data.value: Showing the last real reading. Pace is suppressed until a fresh read succeeds.

data.name: Card_HistoricalDetails
data.value: Showing a persisted reading. Pace is suppressed until a fresh read succeeds.

data.name: Card_HistoryScopeUnavailable
data.value: Live quota is available. Account history is limited to this app session because stable account scope could not be saved.

data.name: Card_ObservedAt
data.comment: {0} = date and time of the last reading (Card_DateTimeFormat).

data.name: Card_MissingApplicationDetails
data.value: Install the provider's official application or command-line tool, then retry.

data.name: Card_NeedsSignInDetails
data.value: Sign in through the provider's official application, then retry.

data.name: Card_AuthenticationExpiredDetails
data.value: Refresh the provider's official sign-in, then retry. Glideslope never asks for your password.

data.name: Card_RateLimitedUntil
data.value: The provider allows another read after {0}.
data.comment: {0} = a time of day in the user's regional short-time format.

data.name: Card_RateLimitedDetails
data.value: The provider asked Glideslope to wait before another read.

data.name: Card_OfflineDetails
data.value: Check the connection and retry. Other provider cards continue independently.

data.name: Card_UnsupportedAccountDetails
data.value: This signed-in account does not expose the supported subscription quota.

data.name: Card_SchemaChangedDetails
data.value: The provider data could not be read safely. Retry after logging into the provider again.

data.name: Card_ProviderUnavailableDetails
data.value: Live data from this provider is not connected yet.

data.name: Card_ChartSampleTooltip
data.comment: {0} = date and time of the reading (Card_DateTimeFormat), {1} = percent remaining, {2} = an age phrase (Card_AgeDays, Card_AgeHours or Card_AgeMinutes).

data.name: Card_AgeDays_One
data.comment: {0} = whole number of days.

data.name: Card_AgeDays_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole number of days.

data.name: Card_AgeHours_One
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal.

data.name: Card_AgeHours_Other
data.comment: {0} = hours with one decimal.

data.name: Card_AgeMinutes_One
data.comment: {0} = whole number of minutes.

data.name: Card_AgeMinutes_Other
data.comment: {0} = whole number of minutes.
